answer: Reputation escrow with slashing, in four steps. (1) A fresh key's first 200 POA of rewards lock for a 14-day horizon. (2) By day 7, three peers must reproduce one unit of work or the payout halves. (3) The raven scanner flags keys sharing a fingerprint cluster; a sybil verdict slashes those escrows to the treasury and kills the keys. (4) A second strike freezes the address for 90 days. Faking 5,000 agents parks 1,000,000 POA for two weeks and needs 15,000 attestations no peer signs. A clone farm is quartz on a beach: each stone looks distinct until you line them up and find one slab.
